description: High-performance multi-model document database for .NET 10, built on SurrealDB. Supports documents, graph edges, event sourcing, live queries, full-text search, time-series, and spatial queries.
rules: Always use async APIs (QuerySessionAsync, SaveChangesAsync) — AeroDB is async-first.
Prefer LINQ queries over raw SurrealQL when possible for type safety.
Use await using for sessions — they implement IAsyncDisposable.
Show complete, runnable examples with DocumentStore.For() configuration callback.
Do not reference AeroDB.Internal.* or AeroDB.Generated.* namespaces.
Use Snowflake IDs (long) for primary keys via Snowflake.NewId() from AeroDB.Snowflake.
For ASP.NET Identity integration, use AddAeroDBStores() extension method.
Use Store() for inserts/updates, Delete() for removals — all changes flush on SaveChangesAsync().
